source: Frozen development-source based on upstream 7e1c17d plus opt-in nail precision; no v1 runs pooled
training_rewards: Hammer SuperMimic nail_std .001 selected by development seed3065; SuperTrack retains its original .01 width. Pen and Relocate retain default task rewards for both methods. All other named Hand accurate adaptation settings unchanged.

evaluation.reporting: Fixed v1 widths, tracking return and normalized error, native final/ever/frame success, all failures retained; float32 deployed prior on identical starts

gate: Run all six Hammer seeds first. Proceed to Pen/Relocate only if every Hammer SuperMimic seed is finite, native final success >= .95 and fixed normalized tracking RMSE <= .1. A failed gate triggers diagnosis, not omission or relabelling of runs.
selection: Preview per task: final run with lowest fixed tracking RMSE among all six method/seed combinations; fixed nominal episode0, full nonterminal window. Report mean and sample SD of three seed means separately from preview selection.

resources.warmup: Exact method/task/width/full network and batches before each full run
resources.headroom: Leave GPUs6-7 and 40 physical cores available; CPU checks occupy four separate cores only; admission and continuous resource monitoring; no unrelated jobs stopped

publication: Separate PR only after completed results, checks and previews; never update Door PR3. It remains an independent prerequisite if unmerged.
